prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: polished game environment design board, one image, high resolution wide horizontal 3840x1920.
Input image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: preserve its bright hand-painted cartoon fantasy, warm sunshine, crisp colored outlines, high-angle three-quarter near-isometric 2.5D thickness, clean varied materials and heroic game proportions. Do NOT copy its mechanical winch or UI.
Create a precisely ordered 4-column by 2-row contact sheet, eight equally sized cells with fine cream parchment gutters and minimal brass borders. Seven cells are SEPARATE INDEPENDENT ROOM ENVIRONMENT PAINTINGS; cell 8 is a fantasy prop collection on cream. Seven spaces must visibly differ in composition and landmarks, not one large map split into tiles. Every room has a wide open traversable center, deliberately arranged rich side props, no random scatter. Camera and character scale consistent across all cells. Continuous warm sand-gold ground with terracotta paving, red sandstone at the distant PERIMETER, indigo textiles, pale ivory bones, fresh turquoise and green accents. Show whimsical living orc/ogre civilization rather than grim military wasteland. A few vivid green or blue orcs and orange ogres, expressive cartoon bodies, remain small and easy to read. Tiny teal magical status beacons belong at three fixed perimeter pockets. No functional game HUD. Only exact room IDs in small dark-purple text on cream badges at the upper left of each cell, in this order:
TOP ROW:
L19: Sun spiral giant drum terrace. A giant gold-ochre drum painted with a spiral sun sits in the UPPER LEFT scenic pocket; broad left-to-right courtyard path curves gently through an open central battle space, with a lower bypass. Side props: smiling bone-tooth entry gate posts, one-eyed indigo sand-beast windsocks, talking horn-helmet straw dummies, three-tone drum rack, a tiny golden tooth trophy, curved rib benches.
L20: Sand-beast street market. A WIDE diagonal southwest-to-northeast street, a sunny laughing-sun arch in upper middle. Distinct cute fire-lizard roast stall, spiky green melon drink cart with pink juice, bone-ball tabletop game, stitched cream shade awnings along UPPER edge, bright ceramic pots, pet snack bowls. An orange potbellied ogre carries stolen amber lanterns. Center street clear.
L21: Open tusk gladiator court. Pale curved-tooth spectator stand only along TOP edge; flat oval-ish open battle floor, side bypass along lower rim. A friendly tiny sand-spider weaves an indigo net on a bone loom at UPPER LEFT, a huge curving rib-bone swing at UPPER RIGHT, colored bead scoreboard, tooth trophies and clan cheering flags. Nets stay in small side pockets, never cover the battle center.
L22: Horn-helmet fantasy workshop. Sun-tooth forge landmark along TOP edge; a wide diagonal corridor through spacious central workshop yard. Giant monster molar anvils, a sneezing red fire-lizard working leather bellows, whimsical sheep/bird/one-eye horn helmet rack, bone-armor mannequins, tiny circular turquoise star-sand quench basins. No old industrial equipment.
BOTTOM ROW:
L23: Wind lantern sunlit ridge. A CONTINUOUS broad sandy stone ridge with a lower loop bypass. Canyon scenery only outside the walkable perimeter, NO trench in this room. Giant curved-horn wind-signal lighthouse at UPPER RIGHT, slender ivory lantern trees on OUTER left and right, terracotta sunflower fire bowls, bone wind gong, horn telescope, three-clan indigo banner, small travel mats. Light airy sky beyond the edge.
L24: Three-clan training court. A sunny linked-tusk trial arch along TOP edge. Broad flat central grounds with TWO DIFFERENT ground-painted training circles, no raised steps, no wall in center. Practice axe rack, talking training dummies, gold-tooth medal tree, triple beat drum rack, a small cozy sleeping sand-beast pet nest at LOWER RIGHT, judging rib bench at lower edge.
BO04: Great chieftain sun arena. Largest open circular PAINTED sun emblem on CONTINUOUS flat ground. Upper edge curved sun-crown champion throne. Three giant wind-signal battle drums at OUTER WEST, NORTH and EAST; small breakable tusk barricades near drums with open bypasses. A charismatic huge orc chieftain with four-horn ivory crown, terracotta layered armor, indigo sash and oversized fantasy axe in center; size readable without occupying whole arena. Minimal spectators benches, heraldic flags, trophies only on edges. No ring fence, no platform step.
Eighth cell has NO ID: a beautifully painted prop sheet of whimsical faction items, different silhouettes and clean spacing: giant rib-bone swing, one-eyed sand-beast windsock, sneezing fire-lizard bellows, friendly sand-spider bone loom, whale-shaped terracotta water urn, sunflower magic fire bowl, giant-tooth anvil, gold-tooth trophy, four-horn crown and indigo drum. Include fantasy equipment with bone/terracotta/indigo materials. No labels or extra text.
All seven rooms should be finished rich 2.5D illustrations, cozy adventurous afternoon mood, painterly details, consistent upper-left light and short readable shadows. Each environment shows 8-12 varied prop types grouped intentionally around the perimeter, wide combat center. Preserve strong visual differences between street market, drum terrace, arena, workshop and airy ridge.
Avoid: repetitive mechanical winches, mine carts, rust coils, rectangular water pools, rectangular holes, interior chasms, giant square blocks, stretched texture walls, generic giant pillars, floating square slab dioramas, gloomy dark palette, horror, blood, dense obstacles, unreadable microtext, duplicate room IDs, large HUD, grainy flat phototextures.
